description: Advisories that the dependency audit check tolerates for a limited time. Each entry names individual advisories, gives a reason and expires. An entry is a decision made by the person who merges the change that adds it. See memory/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Dependency audit'.

exceptions.reason: PostCSS runs only during the build, on this repository's own stylesheets. No user-supplied CSS or source map reaches it at runtime. Next.js 15.5.29 pins its own copy at 8.4.31; a patched copy there needs Next.js 16.
exceptions.plan: Update the root copy with a patch-level lockfile change in a separate pull request. Re-check the copy inside Next.js with each 15.5.x backport release.

exceptions.reason: nanoid is not imported by any file in this repository. It is installed only as a dependency of PostCSS and is used during the build, so no user input reaches it.
exceptions.plan: Update with a patch-level lockfile change in a separate pull request.

exceptions.reason: source-map-js is installed only as a dependency of PostCSS and parses source maps produced by this repository's own build. No user-supplied source map reaches it.
exceptions.plan: Update with a patch-level lockfile change in a separate pull request.

exceptions.reason: No patched 3.x release exists; the fix requires the Zod 4 major upgrade. The advisory needs a very large array to reach an array schema. Every untrusted input validated with Zod here is size-capped first: the client-supplied AI style profile is rejected above 8,192 bytes before parsing (lib/services/requestLimits.ts), and model output is bounded by the output token cap.
exceptions.plan: Migrate to Zod 4 as its own task, with the schema version tests as the safety net.
